Neptune Municipal Court

Address: 25 Neptune Blvd, Neptune City, NJ 07753, United States

Phone: 732-988-5200 732-775-1690

Neptune Municipal Court is a city courthouse in Neptune Township, New Jersey. It's a jam-packed court in that town and receives a lot of traffic tickets and summons. The court has jurisdiction over traffic and DWI matters, harassment and criminal assault, violation of city ordinance, and offense of disorderly persons in that town. The court administrator is responsible for regularly supervising the municipal court's operation.

This court handles which Types of cases?

Neptune City Traffic Court handles cases of traffic DWI and vehicle violations. The violation includes speeding, accidents, using cell phones while driving, failing to follow a traffic signal or traffic control device, driving while intoxicated, with a suspended or no license, leaving the scene of the accident, and driving recklessly. It also handles speeding tickets from township routes 33, 35, and 18. You can send a guilty or not guilty plea to the court before the date written on the ticket you received. The court will respond whether to appear in the court for the case, or only fines will be paid. Your driving license and driving privilege will be suspended if you do not pay the fine on time. You cannot request your license renewal until the court approves. Hire a professional traffic Ticket attorney for traffic and speeding cases because they can defend you against the traffic charges in court.

Neptune Municipal Court handles a variety of cases, including:

  • Traffic violations such as speeding, reckless driving, and driving under the influence (DUI)
  • Disorderly persons offenses such as simple assault, harassment, and disorderly conduct
  • Municipal ordinance violations such as noise violations and building code violations

How to find records?

Neptune Municipal Court records information for any case is available at the court office in files, on the computer, and online. They can be found online by using the following ways:

  • Searching by name
  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Some information about cases is not available online because they are confidential by law, like harassment, criminal offense, etc. These types of information are only available at the court office. You had to submit a form for this information by visiting the court, and then the court would respond whether to provide the record information or not. Mostly confidential information is only given to the person involved in the case or to the police or investigation agency. There is no fee for the record search.

Which offenses fall in Common Disorderly Person?

Neptune Municipal Court handles charges of common offense by a disorderly person. The crimes that fall in that category are attacks, harassment, disorderly conduct, criminal behavior, shoplifting, Marijuana possession of fewer than 50 grams, Drug Paraphernalia possession, alcohol to an underage person, false report, obscenity, withstand arrest, and fake ID charges, etc. These offenses result in a fine conviction, jail, suspension of license and insurance, and conditional dismissal. Hire an attorney if you fall into these offenses.

What are the duties of the clerk?

Neptune Township Municipal Court Clerks' duties are to provide different licenses and permits like marriage, birth, etc., manage public records, vital statistics, landlord registration, and custody of documents. The clerk acts as an administrative official and a secretary to the governing body. They are an agent of licensing and custodians of the town records.

How to make payments?

Neptune Municipal Court pays tickets, and fines can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can pay for traffic tickets and fines by visiting the court during regular court hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. 2.99% convince and other charges will be applied if you pay with a credit card.

Online

A person can make an online payment by using the online portal payment portal. Processing fees will be applied in this online method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address. The address is 25 Neptune Blvd, Neptune City, NJ 07753, United States. Cash or personal checks are not acceptable in the mail; only certified checks are accepted.

How to get a marriage license?

Neptune Municipal Court marriage license is obtained from the clerk's office. The fee for a marriage license is $28 and for certificates is $15 per copy. The couple's age must be 18+.To get the certification, the couple had to submit a marriage form with an original sealed birth certificate issued by the state, photo ids like a driver's license, Passport, or anything that could prove their identity. If this is anyone's second marriage, a divorce paper or spouse death certificate must be required at the time of registration. If anyone wants the copies, fill out the certificated copy of the marriage license request, and submit it to the court. It is valid for up to 30 days. The witness information must also be filled in the application form, and an oath for application and identifying witnesses must also be filled out.

What Should You Expect When Appearing in Neptune Municipal Court?

If you've been charged with a traffic violation or misdemeanor in Neptune Township, you will likely have to appear in Neptune Municipal Court. Here's what you can expect:

  • You will receive a summons or ticket with the date, time, and location of your court appearance.
  • When you arrive at court, you will need to check in with the court clerk.
  • You will then wait for your case to be called. This can take some time, so be prepared to spend several hours in court.
  • When your case is called, you will appear before the judge. The judge will explain the charges against you and ask how you plead.
  • If you plead guilty, the judge will impose a sentence. If you plead not guilty, your case will be scheduled for trial.

How Should You Prepare for Your Court Appearance?

If you've been charged with a traffic violation or misdemeanor in Neptune Township, it's important to be prepared for your court appearance. Here's what you should do:

  • Read the summons or ticket carefully and make note of the date, time, and location of your court appearance.
  • Dress appropriately for court. You should dress in business attire, such as a suit or dress.
  • Gather any evidence or witnesses that can help your case.
  • Speak with an attorney if you have any questions or concerns about your case.

What Should You Do If You've Been Charged with a Traffic Violation or Misdemeanor in Neptune?

If you've been charged with a traffic violation or misdemeanor in Neptune Township, it's important to take the charges seriously. Here's what you should do:

  • Read the summons or ticket carefully and make note of the date, time, and location of your court appearance.
  • Speak with an attorney as soon as possible. An attorney can help you understand the charges against you and develop a defense strategy.
  • Gather any evidence or witnesses that can help your case.
  • Prepare for your court appearance by dressing appropriately and being on time.
  • Be respectful to the judge and court staff. Remember, they are there to help you.

Conclusion

If you've been charged with a traffic violation or misdemeanor in Neptune Township, it's important to take the charges seriously and be prepared for your court appearance. By understanding what to expect and how to prepare, you can increase your chances of a favorable outcome. Remember, speaking with an attorney can help you understand the charges against you and develop a defense strategy.

FAQ:

What happens if I fill in the wrong information in the marriage form and fill out the oath?

If you fill in the wrong information in the marriage form and fill out the oath, then a fine of $7500.

So fill in the information correctly.

What are the fees for the certified copy of the birth and death certificate?

$15 per copy is the fee for the certified copy of the birth and death certificate.

What is the responsibility of court administration?

Neptune Municipal Court administration is responsible for carrying out all rules and regulations, speaking with the person that comes to court for complaints, etc.

How can I contact the clerk's office?

Visit the clerk's office during working hours or call them for any information or guidance.

Phone: 732-776-7224 Ext. 41.

I was involved in criminal cases. Is court appearance mandatory?

Yes, a court appearance is necessary if criminal charges are against you.
